webPolicies.kind: OpenVireo web domain (new behavior, not recovered)
webPolicies.title: Exact admission of TSkyCoordsDlg sums
webPolicies.rule: S = |a| + |b|/60 + |c|/3600 and R = a + sign(b/60 + c/3600) over exact field decimals. R outside the range by more than 2^-50 x S -> original range error box. Else S > 1e6 (hours/degrees) -> unsupported 'cancellation'. Else R outside the range -> unsupported 'precision'. Else store the nearest binary64 of R (ties to even); never clamped.
webPolicies.rationale: Independent exact-algebra controls (/home/dobleuber/Documents/Codex/2026-10-18/task-3/radio-antenna-independent/ra-adversarial-results.json) showed the earlier binary64 accumulation admitting 1 h for an exact 2 h entry, rejecting an exact 0 h entry as a range error and admitting 24.000000000000001 h as 24. The bound 2^-50 exceeds gamma_4 for binary64 (four roundings per term), so out-of-range verdicts outside it hold for every faithful >=53-bit evaluation; S <= 1e6 bounds that disagreement by ~8.9e-10 h or degrees.
webPolicies.differsFromNative: Native has no limit on S and decides near-bound entries by its own Extended rounding. The browser refuses those cases instead of guessing, and admits every exactly in-range entry.
webPolicies.code: src/core/radioAntenna.ts SKY_COORDS_WEB_DOMAIN, parseExactDecimal, nearestBinary64, admitCoordinate, parseSkyCoords

numericPolicy: binary64 throughout, except coordinate entry, which is evaluated exactly (BigInt rationals) and admitted per WEB-NUM-01. Extended operands are rounded once to binary64. Single operands (60, 3600, 0, 24, ±90, 12, 15, 10) are exact. Power(10, index-3) is evaluated as Number exponentiation. No x87 control-word or Extended rounding emulation. RA normalization follows the 0x4bad9c port policy of A06 (signed fractional turn, +24, rounded 24 -> 0). Display seconds use Number.toFixed (half away from zero on the exact binary value) for FloatToStrF ffFixed.

webOptionProfile.policy: Shape-valid host options are supported only if initial Dec is finite within [-90,90] degrees and all reachable rate indices 1..max(4,maxRateIndex) produce finite positive advancing Dec/RA steps, with RA step < 6 h. Refuse without clamping. Not native options validation.
webOptionProfile.stateContext: radioLabRateIssues applies the same rate criteria to the rate each next step would use, because RateSpin (0x566784/0x566838) is the only recompute and the start loop (0x566f6b) only raises the index to the options maximum, so an index above max(4,maxRateIndex) set under earlier options or by a restored host state is kept. 'stored' (running or paused slew) refuses SlewTimer2 callbacks with outcome rate-unsupported and the panel registers no interval; 'start' (rate after the raise loop) refuses OK and Yes; 'down'/'up' refuses a RateSpin press during a slew.
